location: D-E, L8; ex church at Sebnitz, near Dresden. Presented by the weaver’s guild in Sebnitz to the local church, 1725. Played in the Sebnitz church through the end of the 19th cen.  [Herbert: L8, 1.12.5]Herbert: On loan from Heimatmuseum, Sebnitz—same for others by Müller]
signature: "Macht Iohann Myller in Alt Dresden Anno 1725"; coat of arms of the Sebnitz guild of weavers; "Diese Poasavnen hat zv Christi milden Angedencken, Eine werthe Weber Zvnt Gottes Tempel wollen schencken Gott zv Ehren thaten sie auf die walthuns volle Hand, Der erhalte sie davor stets in FLORISANTEN stand“; „Zum Andencken schreibs C. G. Heintze / Cantor zu Sebnitz den 19. May“; "Als die .4. Ober. Aeltesten P. Caspar I. Endler C. Klemler L. Scheffler"; „Als die 2 Handwercks Vorgehern / H. G. Endler L Bysel“.
dimensions: bo 8.9 [****ask Heyde ; see Bachhaus cat.], mouthpiece entry 12.7****,  be 104.5, l 1829 (1878 - 49), bore 76% cylindrical, 24% conical/hyperbolic.
remarks: 6 pos.; bell end at 3rd pos. Tubular slide stays, moveable stay telescopic. Keine Manschetten****. Saxon-style rim-wire. Flat bell-stay. Solder repair in bell. Mount for music lyre. 17252 and 17253 are from the same set.
